create_jsonl_metric_recorder: create a JsonlMetricRecorder to record metric values to JSONL files in an output directory
record_metric_values: record metric values for a category with optional step number to a JSONL stream
sanitize_metric_values: sanitize metric values converting tensors and sequences to JSON-serializable types
get_or_create_stream: get or create a JSONL file stream for a given metric category
close_metric_recorder: close all open JSONL streams and clear the stream cache in the recorder
